title: 含两个电容的运放电路：结点法求相量
statement: 图示电路中运放为理想运放，接成电压跟随器（输出端直接接反相输入端）。Us = 2∠0° V（有效值），ω = 1000 rad/s，R1 = R2 = 1 kΩ，C1 = C2 = 1 µF；C1 从结点 m 接到输出端 o。
用结点电压法求输出电压 U_o 的有效值和相位、结点 m 的电压 U_m，以及 C1 中的电流 I_C1（参考方向见图）。

questions.explain: 解出 U_o = −j1 V，|U_o| = 1 V（只有输入的一半）。

questions.ask: C1 中电流的有效值 I_C1 = ?
questions.explain: I_C1 = jωC1(U_m − U_o) = j1 mS × (1 − j + j) V = j1 mA，有效值 1 mA，超前 Us 90°。

hints: 跟随器：U_− = U_o，虚短 U_p = U_+ = U_−，所以 U_p = U_o；虚断：结点 p 不向运放输入端流出电流。
结点 p 只有 R2 和 C2：(U_m − U_o)/R2 = jωC2·U_o，先用 U_o 表示 U_m。
结点 m：(Us − U_m)/R1 = (U_m − U_o)/R2 + jωC1(U_m − U_o)。注意 C1 的另一端接的是输出 o，不是地。
solution: **1. 已知量。** 1/R = 1 mS，jωC = j1 mS（ωRC = 1）。跟随器 + 虚短：U_p = U_o。
**3. 结点 m。** (Us − U_m)·1 mS = (U_m − U_o)·1 mS + (U_m − U_o)·j1 mS，即 Us − U_m = (1 + j)(U_m − U_o)。
**5. 验算（结点 m 的 KCL）。** 流入：(2 − 1 + j)/1k = 1 + j1 mA；流出：R2 中 1 mA，C1 中 j1 mA，合计 1 + j1 mA ✓。
这是一个二阶有源低通滤波器（Sallen–Key 型）；在 ω = 1/(RC) 处输出滞后 90°、幅值为输入的 1/2。

en.title: Op-amp circuit with two capacitors: phasors by nodal analysis
statement: The ideal op-amp is connected as a voltage follower (output tied directly to the inverting input). Us = 2∠0° V (rms), ω = 1000 rad/s, R1 = R2 = 1 kΩ, C1 = C2 = 1 µF; C1 goes from node m to the output o.
Use nodal analysis to find the rms value and phase of the output voltage U_o, the voltage U_m of node m, and the current I_C1 in C1 (reference direction as drawn).

questions.explain: The solution is U_o = −j1 V, |U_o| = 1 V (half the input).
Node p: (U_m − U_o)/R2 = jωC2·U_o → U_m = (1 + jωR2C2)U_o = (1 + j)(−j) = 1 − j V, |U_m| = 1.414 V.
I_C1 = jωC1(U_m − U_o) = j1 mS × (1 − j + j) V = j1 mA: 1 mA rms, leading Us by 90°.

hints: Follower: U_− = U_o, and the virtual short gives U_p = U_+ = U_−, so U_p = U_o; the virtual open means no current leaves node p into the op-amp input.
Node p has only R2 and C2: (U_m − U_o)/R2 = jωC2·U_o; express U_m in terms of U_o first.
Node m: (Us − U_m)/R1 = (U_m − U_o)/R2 + jωC1(U_m − U_o). Note that the other end of C1 is the output o, not ground.
solution: **1. Data.** 1/R = 1 mS, jωC = j1 mS (ωRC = 1). Follower + virtual short: U_p = U_o.
**2. Node p (virtual open).** (U_m − U_o)/R2 = jωC2·U_o → U_m = (1 + jωR2C2)U_o = **(1 + j)U_o**.
**3. Node m.** (Us − U_m)·1 mS = (U_m − U_o)·1 mS + (U_m − U_o)·j1 mS, i.e. Us − U_m = (1 + j)(U_m − U_o).
With U_m − U_o = jU_o: Us − (1 + j)U_o = (1 + j)·jU_o = (−1 + j)U_o → Us = j2U_o → **U_o = Us/(j2) = −j1 V = 1∠−90° V**.
**4. Other quantities.** U_m = (1 + j)(−j) = 1 − j V = **1.414∠−45° V**; I_C1 = j1 mS × (U_m − U_o) = j1 mS × 1 V = **j1 mA**.
**5. Check (KCL at m).** In: (2 − 1 + j)/1k = 1 + j1 mA; out: 1 mA in R2 and j1 mA in C1, total 1 + j1 mA ✓.
This is a second-order active low-pass filter (Sallen–Key type); at ω = 1/(RC) the output lags by 90° with half the input amplitude.
